sources.classification: labelled from the task code, 2026-10-09; draft, self-checked against the analyzer's answer (disagreements resolved from the code)
sources.measurements: Reference values. Source: Krauncher calibration runs on rented hosts (March-September 2026), the same data the analyzer's calibrator is fitted on, so this is not an independent check. Geometric mean over runs.
sources.reference_sec: whole task measured on the reference card; RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell
sources.min_vram_gb: median vram_peak_mb (31093 MB) over completed tasks with this entry_point, all configurations mixed; device memory from nvidia-smi, polled every 10 s
sources.compute_ratio: measured compute (exec - io - setup) on a GPU, on its rented hosts, over the same on the reference card brought to the ideal host with the analyzer's host model (566.0 s), per ladder gpu_id.
